description: Look up any public API for an agent: finds its OpenAPI spec and llms.txt/docs, and returns base URL, auth scheme, rate-limit and error notes, key endpoints and source links (LLM-condensed, cached 7d). Input: {api} (name like 'stripe', a domain, or docs URL), optional {question}. Costs $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (Base preferred, or Solana); no charge on errors. Free tier: pass free_trial=true (10 calls/day).

api.description: API name, domain or docs URL

free_trial.description: set true to use the free tier (10 calls/day) without payment

question.description: optional focus, e.g. 'how to create a payment'

x402_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload; omit to receive payment requirements

name: api_lookup
